# A.I. Disclosure:  All unit tests are generated by Anthropic Claude Code.

set(UNITY_SRC       ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/unity/unity.c)
set(SRC_DIR         ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source/)
set(APP_SRC         ${SRC_DIR}/app)
set(SYNTH_COMMON )

set(WARNINGS
    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -Werror
    -Wdouble-promotion
    -Wpointer-arith

    # GCC-only: no Clang equivalent, so only apply it for that compiler.
    $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU>:-Wunsuffixed-float-constants>

    -Wno-unused-parameter
    -Wno-unused-variable
    -Wno-unused-function
    -Wno-unused-but-set-variable
    -Wno-unused-value
    -Wno-unused-label
    -Wno-unused-local-typedefs
  )

# Mirrors the -D values the real app build passes on the command line
# (see root CMakeLists.txt DEFS_APP) - the dsp/control sources read these
# as plain macros and don't include audio_defs.h themselves, so the test
# build has to supply them the same way rather than via that header.
set(AUDIO_DEFS
    AUDIO_BLOCK_SIZE=128u
    AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE=48000u
  )


set(SYNTH_SOURCES
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/synth.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/keys.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/assign_poly.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/assign_mono.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/voice.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/map.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/patch.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/mod.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/chorus.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dco.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dca.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dcf.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/env.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/lfo.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/noise.c
    ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/shape.c
    ${APP_SRC}/midi/midi_parser.c
)

foreach(TEST_RUNNER
    test_midi.c
    test_synth.c
    test_voice.c
    test_env.c
    test_dco.c
    test_dcf.c
    test_dca.c
    test_shape.c
    test_param.c
    test_map.c
    test_patch.c
    test_patch_store.c
    test_mod.c
    test_display.c
    test_btn_gesture.c
    test_ring_menu.c
    test_audio.c
    test_modal_menu.c
    test_keys.c
    test_assign_poly.c
    test_assign_mono.c
)
    get_filename_component(TEST_NAME ${TEST_RUNNER} NAME_WE)
    set(TEST_DEFS)
    set(TEST_INCLUDES)

    # MIDI tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_midi.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/midi/midi_parser.c
        )
    endif()

    # Envelope tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_env.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/env.c
        )
    endif()

    # DCO tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_dco.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dco.c
        )
    endif()

    # DCF tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_dcf.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dcf.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
        )
    endif()

    # DCA tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_dca.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dca.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
        )
    endif()

    # shape tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_shape.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/shape.c
        )
    endif()

    # Parameter descriptor table tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_param.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
        )
    endif()

    # MIDI CC -> parameter mapping tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_map.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/map.c
        )
    endif()

    # Factory patch / default patch tests
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_patch.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/patch.c
        )
    endif()

    # User patch wire-format tests - pure pack/unpack, no EEPROM dependency
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_patch_store.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/patch.c
            ${APP_SRC}/patch/patch_store.c
        )
    endif()

    # Modulation matrix tests - pure array math, no other module needed
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_mod.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/mod.c
        )
    endif()

    # Character display tests - grid/dirty-row/font logic only, no
    # dependency on the hardware UI layer (lcd.c) at all.
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_display.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/display.c
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/font/font_ui.c
        )
    endif()

    # Button gesture tests - pure press/release timing state machine, no
    # dependency on the hardware debounce layer (buttons.c) at all.
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_btn_gesture.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/btn_gesture.c
        )
    endif()

    # Keys layer tests - pure logic, no audio (design section 4)
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_keys.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/keys.c
        )
    endif()

    # Modal (patch) menu tests - the patch store and audio engine are stubbed
    # in the test file; stubs/eeprom.h stands in for the hardware header.
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_modal_menu.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/menu/modal_menu.c
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/display.c
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/font/font_ui.c
        )
        set(TEST_INCLUDES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stubs)
    endif()

    # Audio engine tests - audio.c with a stub audio_start() in the test file
    # standing in for the I2S driver, so the DMA interrupt can be simulated.
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_audio.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/audio/audio.c
        )
    endif()

    # Ring menu tests - validates the page/field tables against the
    # parameter descriptors, and the navigation/stepping logic.  Renders
    # into the display grid, so needs display.c and the font.
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_ring_menu.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/menu/ring_menu.c
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/display.c
            ${APP_SRC}/ui/font/font_ui.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/patch.c
        )
    endif()

    # Voice tests - the control-plane state machine plus the dsp signal
    # chain it drives, but no MIDI mapping or factory patch machinery.
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_voice.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/voice.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/param.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/patch.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dco.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dca.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/dcf.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/env.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/lfo.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/control/mod.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/noise.c
            ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp/shape.c

            ${APP_SRC}/midi/midi_parser.c
        )
    endif()

    # Synth tests
    # The whole synth (control plane + DSP) - the acceptance tests and the
    # assigner tests drive it through synth_handle_midi()
    if(TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_synth.c" OR
       TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_assign_poly.c" OR
       TEST_RUNNER STREQUAL "test_assign_mono.c")
        set(TEST_DEPS ${SYNTH_SOURCES})

        set(TEST_DEFS
            SYNTH_MAX_VOICES=6
            MAX_VOICES=SYNTH_MAX_VOICES
        )
    endif()

    add_executable(${TEST_NAME}
        ${TEST_RUNNER}
        ${UNITY_SRC}
        ${TEST_DEPS}
    )
    target_compile_options(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE ${WARNINGS})
    target_compile_definitions(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE ${AUDIO_DEFS})
    if(TEST_DEFS)
        target_compile_definitions(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE ${TEST_DEFS})
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE m)
    if(TEST_INCLUDES)
        target_include_directories(${TEST_NAME} BEFORE PRIVATE ${TEST_INCLUDES})
    endif()
    target_include_directories(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/unity
        ${APP_SRC}
        ${APP_SRC}/midi
        ${APP_SRC}/audio
        ${APP_SRC}/patch
        ${APP_SRC}/synth/control
        ${APP_SRC}/synth/dsp
        ${APP_SRC}/ui
        ${APP_SRC}/ui/menu
        ${SRC_DIR}/hardware/bsp
    )
    add_test(NAME ${TEST_NAME} COMMAND ${TEST_NAME})
endforeach()

enable_testing()
